passage.label: disbelievers continue until see promised then know who weaker helpers less number; Say not know what promised near or Lord grant long period; Knower unseen does not disclose unseen anyone except approved messengers sends before each messenger behind observers; may know conveyed messages Lord encompassed whatever with them enumerated all things number

arabicExcerpts.text: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرٗا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدٗا
قُلۡ إِنۡ أَدۡرِيٓ أَقَرِيبٞ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّيٓ أَمَدًا
عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيۡبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٖ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِۦ رَصَدٗا
لِّيَعۡلَمَ أَن قَدۡ أَبۡلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَأَحۡصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدَۢا

mainSubject.label: Disbelievers continuing until they see what was promised, at which point they will know who is weaker in helpers and fewer in number; the Prophet's ignorance of whether the promise is near or distant affirmed; Allah named Knower of the unseen who discloses it to none except approved messengers, sending observers before and behind each messenger so He may verify their conveyance, having encompassed all they carry and enumerated everything in number

notes: Wave 10 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the unjust-as-firewood verdict (15) before the istiqamah-provision and masjid-purity block opens (16); P2 ends with the eternal-Hellfire verdict for disobedience (23) before the eschatological-timing and unseen-knowledge block begins (24); P3 covers the promise-visibility, timing-ignorance and guarded-unseen disclosure (24-28).
